# **🔹 About Us (Alignable Version)**

The Luxora Collective is a growth partner for med spa and wellness practice owners who are ready to scale with structure, not guesswork.

Most clinics don’t have a lead problem. They have a system problem.

We work with established practices to build full revenue systems that take a client from first click all the way through booking, consultation, treatment plans, and long-term retention.

Our approach is built around three core areas:
• Data-driven market strategy before ad spend  
• High-converting acquisition and booking systems  
• Retention, memberships, and lifetime value growth  

We focus on what actually drives revenue, not vanity metrics. That means fixing show rates, improving consult performance, strengthening follow-up, and turning one-time clients into long-term patients.

If your business is generating leads but not converting consistently, there is usually a leak in the system. That is exactly where we come in.

We don’t guess. We assess.

---

# **🔹 How We Got Started**

The Luxora Collective was built from the inside of the med spa industry, not from the outside looking in.

Before moving into marketing, Bethany spent over a decade working inside medical aesthetics, from front desk to office management, helping run multiple locations. That experience exposed a consistent pattern across practices.

Most clinics were investing heavily into marketing but still struggling with inconsistent revenue, low show rates, underperforming staff, and little to no retention strategy.

It became clear that the issue wasn’t traffic. It was everything that happened after the lead came in.

After transitioning into marketing and working with practices across the country, Bethany saw the same gaps repeated over and over. Leads were being generated, but there were no systems in place to convert, follow up, or retain those clients.

The Luxora Collective was created to solve that problem.

Instead of offering fragmented services, the focus became building complete, scalable revenue systems that align marketing, operations, and client experience into one cohesive engine.

Today, Luxora works with med spa and wellness businesses across the U.S. to help them turn inconsistent growth into predictable, systemized revenue.
